message.content:
I need to find which function or method declared under `internal/` in this Go repository has the highest inbound-call count (fan-in) — i.e., the most callers across the entire codebase.

The repo is at /bench/home/work. The `internal/` directory has these subdirectories: ai, base, email, filter, httpgetter, idp, markdown, motionphoto, profile, scheduler, storage, testutil, util, version, webhook.

Approach:
1. First, extract all exported function/method names declared in `internal/` Go files (skip test files). Use `grep -rn` to find `func ` declarations.
2. For each function found, count how many times it's called across the entire codebase (grep for the function name, excluding its own declaration, excluding test files if you want — but actually include all callers including tests).
3. Report the function with the highest count of unique calling locations.

Focus on exported functions (capitalized names) since those are more likely to be called from many places. Also check commonly used utility functions.

Be thorough — check ALL packages under internal/. Pay special attention to packages like `util`, `filter`, `storage`, `testutil` as these tend to have high fan-in utility functions.

Report: function name, file where declared, and approximate number of call sites found.

done | sort -u

input.command:
# Count occurrences of each package.Function across all .go files, excluding the declaration itself
# Also handle method calls like obj.Method where Method is from internal/
# Focus on package-level calls first (the most reliable)

declare -A seen
while IFS='|' read -r qualname file; do
  if [ -z "$qualname" ] || [[ "$qualname" == .* ]]; then continue; fi
  if [ -n "${seen[$qualname]}" ]; then continue; fi
  seen[$qualname]=1
  
  # Count occurrences excluding func declarations
  count=$(grep -rn "\b${qualname}\b" --include='*.go' . 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^[^:]*:[0-9]*:func " | wc -l)
  echo "$count $qualname ($file)"
done < <(grep -rn '^func ' internal/ --include='*.go' | grep -v '_test.go' | while IFS= read -r line; do
  file=$(echo "$line" | cut -d: -f1)
  pkg=$(head -5 "$file" | grep '^package ' | awk '{print $2}')
  funcname=$(echo "$line" | grep -oP 'func (\([^)]+\) )?[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]*' | sed 's/^func //; s/^([^)]*) //')
  if [ -n "$funcname" ] && [ -n "$pkg" ]; then
    echo "$pkg.$funcname|$file"
  fi
done | sort -u) | sort -rn | head -50
input.description: Count package-qualified call sites for all exported internal/ functions
